title: Kerala High Court Passes Fresh Order Granting Police Protection To Viral Kumbh Mela Star
description: The Kerala High Court on Tuesday (July 21) passed a fresh order granting police protection to viral Kumbh Mela star. The order was passed in a plea moved by the star alleging that hate campaigns were propagated against her on mainstream media and online platforms following her marriage to her husband Mohammed Farmaan, a Muslim man.
